lines: h1
GTA 6 is lying to you in every single frame.
h2
That whole city? Most of it isn't even being drawn.
h3
At thirty frames per second, a console gets thirty-three milliseconds per picture. So every big open world cheats. Four ways.
t1
Trick one. LOD. Up close, this car is thirty-five thousand triangles. Far away, almost nothing. You never notice.
t2
Trick two. Culling. Behind you? Not drawn. Behind a building? Not drawn.
t3
Trick three. Streaming. The map is cut into tiles. Drive forward, and the ones behind you unload.
t4
Trick four. Instancing. These hundred pedestrians are one model, drawn a hundred times.
p1
Stack all four, and a whole city fits inside thirty-three milliseconds. It only exists where you're looking.
p2
The best optimization is the one you never see.
b1
Every game model gets built in levels like this. Vi3W makes the first one from one sketch, in seconds.
